reference.role: Road bends, cluster spacing and grouped foliage

observations: Viewed all three final images. The main road now has alternating bends clearly visible in both plan and north-facing massing; gate and bridge ends remain fixed.

Compared at identical scale: removed quay-to-main, service-to-arrival and old-park returns are visible; the new north circuit and shared yard connector remain explicit. The 35 percent road-reduction aim is not reached and is disclosed in the report.
Dense overlapping canopy clumps replace the even single-tree distribution; broad open meadow is visible between groups, with a few accents beside the HQ and main road.
Civic paving follows an irregular boundary around the tower, with two trees in an eastern planted island. Blue appointment dots remain visibly on paving.
The south-east enclosure has a broken irregular hedge, staggered household bed groups and compact stacked fence stock by the tool shed. Legacy allotment uses are preserved.
Cluster numbers, legends, titles, scale bars and comparison captions are readable and fit the canvases. The oblique image shows retained roof palettes and is labelled as a geometry study.
limits: 35 percent road length/area aim not achieved.
Not a Godot capture or runtime occlusion test.
